summary: Sets the requested clip length to 4, 6, or 8 seconds. The apparent choice narrows to 8 seconds when the request uses a first or last frame, typed reference images, video extension, 1080p, or 4k.
combines: Lixpi normalizes frame-conditioned, extension, 1080p, and 4k requests to 8 seconds before sending them, so an otherwise valid matrix selection cannot reach Google as an incompatible combination.
Veo extension adds roughly seven seconds of new material even though the request must carry durationSeconds=8.

usage.from: state.videoDurationSeconds, validated from the selected Veo model's Duration control
usage.what: Sends the selected duration and normalizes frame-conditioned, extension, 1080p, and 4k requests to eight seconds.
